notes: Task side of the task/environment split. Current MAS ground-truth dataset: 600 tasks across 8 domains (finance 90, hr 85, marketing 80, operations 80, support 80, sales 80, healthcare 55, legal 50). Each task = user_query + ground_truth (required / forbidden plus MAS required_steps and forbidden_actions) + link to dataset/environments/<task_id>.json + key_constraint + metadata. Environments are rich tool pools (necessary + forbidden + tangential); any tool not in forbidden is free to use; violation = calling a forbidden tool (blocklist / default-allow). generic_environment holds always-available task-independent tools such as ask_user. MAS enrichment adds required_steps (target/param-level, weighted) and forbidden_actions (audience-level); original required/forbidden are kept for diagnostics and C1 rule judging.
